# Version 4.151.0 (Unreleased)
> **Vulkan, performance, and platform reach**

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.151.0 adds a Vulkan Silk.NET package, memory and performance fixes, and broader platform support. This release adds the new SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET integration package, brings FreeType-based font rendering to Nano Server, fixes a native memory leak in SKImage.Create, and sharpens runtime performance via reduced allocations.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia submodule synced to latest upstream** — Pulls in the latest Skia engine changes and refreshes the cgmanifest to keep the bundled renderer current. ([#4537](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4537))

## API Surface

- **New SkiaSharp.Vulkan.Silk.NET package** — Adds a first-class Vulkan integration package that targets Silk.NET, with Vulkan test coverage running on both Android and Linux CI legs. ([#4527](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4527))

## Bug Fixes

- **Native memory leak in SKImage.Create raster failure path fixed** — A CoTaskMem pixel buffer was not freed when the raster image creation failed, causing a native memory leak on every failed create call. ([#4455](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4455))

## Lifecycle & Internals

- **Reduced allocations in hot text and shader paths** — GetEncodedText avoids an intermediate string allocation on the null-terminated fast path, and SKRuntimeEffectUniforms pre-sizes its lookup map to the known uniform count, cutting per-frame allocations. ([#4498](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4498), [#4512](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4512))

## Platform

- **FreeType font support for Nano Server** — Nano Server's restricted GDI environment no longer prevents font rendering: the build now uses FreeType as the font backend, fixing long-standing text rendering failures on Nano Server containers. — ❤️ [@jeffska](https://github.com/jeffska) ([#4280](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4280))
- **Containerized test coverage for Azure Linux, Alpine/musl, and Nano Server** — New CI test legs run the full SkiaSharp test suite inside Azure Linux, Alpine (musl libc), and Nano Server containers, catching platform-specific regressions earlier. ([#4515](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4515))
- **Solutions migrated to .slnx format** — All .sln solution files have been converted to the new .slnx format, reducing merge noise and aligning with modern .NET tooling. ([#4528](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/4528))
